svg.text: colour: most common digit of a cell
red outline: hotspot, where digits mix
of the winner on the grid.
The batch version used here (NNSOM, hexagonal grid) has no learning rate α: after each pass over the data,
is set to a weighted average of the embeddings whose winner lies within
shrinks from 11 to 1 over the 250 epochs, so the map first orders itself and then fits the data.
